```{r}
#| label: setup
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(IssueTrackeR)
library(htmltools)
library(here)

# IssueTrackerR configs
options(IssueTrackeR.dataset.dir = here::here("data/gh"))
options(IssueTrackeR.owner = "ImperialCollegeLondon")
options(IssueTrackeR.repo = "ve_data_science")

# Set global options for all DT tables
options(
  DT.options = list(
    pageLength = 5,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    # 2. Pre-populate specific column filters
    searchCols = list(
      NULL,
      NULL,
      NULL,
      list(search = '["open"]'),
      NULL
    )
  )
)

# function to render the interactive table
render_issues <- function(issue) {
  issue |>
    select(-milestone) |>
    datatable(
      rownames = FALSE,
      colnames = c(
        "Issue" = "number",
        "Title" = "title",
        "Body (truncated)" = "body",
        "State" = "state",
        "Created at" = "created_at"
      ),
      filter = "top",
      escape = 2
    )
}

# function for a HTML progress bar
progress_bar <- function(x, total = 100, color = "#2c7bb6") {
  pct <- round(x / total * 100)
  lbl <- paste0(pct, "% complete; ", total - x, " open; ", x, " closed")

  tags$div(
    style = "margin: 1rem 0",
    tags$div(
      style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #555; margin-bottom: 4px;",
      tags$span("Progress"),
      tags$span(lbl)
    ),
    tags$div(
      style = "background: #e9ecef; border-radius: 999px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden;",
      tags$div(
        style = glue::glue(
          "width: {pct}%; height: 100%; background: {color};
           border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.6s ease;"
        )
      )
    )
  )
}

# function that applies progress_bar() to a milestone object
progress_bar_milestone <- function(milestone, ...) {
  tmp <- milestones |> filter(title == milestone)
  n_closed <- tmp$nb_issues_closed
  n_total <- tmp$nb_issues_open + tmp$nb_issues_closed
  progress_bar(n_closed, n_total, ...)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: read-issues
# download GitHub issues
issues <- get_issues(source = "online", state = "all", verbose = FALSE)
milestones <- get_milestones(source = "online", state = "all", verbose = FALSE)

# write_to_dataset(issues)
# update_database()

# prepare the issue tracker table
issue_table <-
  issues |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(creator == "hrlai") |>
  # Convert NA milestones to a string for grouping
  mutate(milestone = replace_na(as.character(milestone), "No Milestone")) |>
  # Arrange by milestone, then by our custom state order
  mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("open", "closed"))) |>
  arrange(milestone, state, desc(created_at)) |>
  # cleaner dates
  mutate_at(vars(created_at, closed_at), ymd) |>
  # Create a column for the linked number
  mutate(
    number = sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', html_url, number),
    body = str_trunc(body, 100),
  ) |>
  select(number, title, body, state, milestone, created_at)
```

# Overview {#sec-overview}

## Progress: closed Issues and PRs

- I updated `build_config.R` to reproduce the compiled configuration for Maliau 2 ([#637](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/637 "Update build_config.R to reproduce the compiled config.toml for Maliau 2")) and patched it using `tomledit` to preserve numerical precision ([#640](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/640 "Patch build_config.R with tomledit to preserve numerical precision")).
- I added the Miyamoto 2015 dataset to validation ([#646](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/646 "Validation: add Miyamoto 2015")) and resolved an R test failure ([#645](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/pull/645 "Fix R test")).

- **Ongoing Discussions**: I am coordinating on database and validation workflows—including variable aggregation dependencies between `valdb.R` and `get_ve_variables.R` ([#650](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/650#issuecomment-5777503843 "Issue 650")), parameterisation database structures ([#644](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/644#issuecomment-5771168363 "Issue 644")), using Miyamoto 2015 data ([#523](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/523#issuecomment-5770589651 "Issue 523")), spatial bounding box definitions ([#651](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/651#issuecomment-5777401379 "Issue 651")), time-step integration for unequal intervals ([#451](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/451#issuecomment-5757037770 "Issue 451")), and enabling full-paper access for LLMs ([#629](https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/ve_data_science/issues/629#issuecomment-5853811675 "Issue 629")).
